purpose: Compact, source-linked knowledge records for TIMDR-AI-Core. This is evidence for a logical gate, not a prompt that authorizes an AI to create empirical results.

records.claim: AI may enforce preregistration, control, branch separation, definition consistency and falsification reporting; it is not a mathematical or empirical authority and cannot promote a result to SUPPORTED.
Every claim must be labeled as mathematics, code, empirical result, or AI interpretation; only reproducible frozen empirical work can establish empirical status.
M/S, G, K and META-DYNAMICS are distinct branches with their own objects and operators; shared names do not identify the objects.
Chronoprocess supplies one time carrier and separate M/S, G and K projections; it does not merge their operators.
Definitions and thresholds are preregistered before final-test data; calibration on disjoint train/calibration data is allowed, while post-holdout changes are exploratory.
A diagnostic evaluated on an independently chosen candidate is not thereby a selector for unlabeled candidates.
The Fourier M/S-K bridge is exact for a single ideal Gaussian impulse and is not established as a diagnostic for arbitrary real events.
The current MC K-G configuration is rejected because lattice-density near the ground state can create a high base rate unrelated to signal structure.
